items: Commerce and Justice describe their chip investigation as Representative Brian Mast asks for records.
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and company lawyer Tim Teter agree to House interviews.
Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook declines White House removal hearing unless procedures change.
U.S. strikes missile site on Iran’s Qeshm Island after Iran targets a radar installation in Bahrain.
Iran targets an air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain after the U.S. strike on Qeshm.
Associated Press calls Alaska’s Senate race for Mary Peltola, projecting 56 Democratic seats.
Representative Robert Garcia asks Vance and other Trump officials to keep records for House inquiries.
Pentagon official Elbridge Colby urges Ukraine’s backers to prioritize front-line equipment.
Trump and Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul say trade talks are nearly complete.
Updated the administration and nomination assessments with the election, records requests and military developments.
Added personnel and nomination reviews with the prior estimates held.
